gen-gf-goldman-gf-hammersmith-one: Commanding in mood, Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like forms wide across the line. Hammersmith One follows in rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, a plain sans that stays quiet beside it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Goldman stretches its round, parenthesis-shaped letters wide, with a lowercase that stands surprisingly tall against its capitals. Kdam Thmor Pro fills its line with full bowls.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-major-mono-display: Goldman takes charge with wide, confident letters that command attention. Major Mono Display offers tube-like neon strokes and generous sidebearings, so its monospace text feels precise and technical beside that heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Modern and level, the sans text of Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified even at a modest size, with an unvarying weight. Goldman sits above it with wide, bold letters, so any size adjustment belongs to the body.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed brings pen-lifted curves left open and a big x-height, all in unmodulated strokes. Sofia Sans Condensed keeps a long stretch of text friendly and plain sans simple, while Goldman up top stays bold and wide.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-tiny5: Goldman stretches wide and bold, its round forms opening like parentheses across the line. Tiny5 sits below with tall letters and short-looking ascenders.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-victor-mono: Goldman is wide, round and bold, a heading with real command. Victor Mono is the monospace counterpart, precise and loosely spaced, with bowls left open on one side.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-voces: Bold and commanding, Goldman opens wide with a tall lowercase over its capitals, while Voces adds gentle stroke modulation underneath. Voces stays professional beside it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-winky-rough: Commanding and wide, Goldman leads with round forms like open parentheses, while Winky Rough follows in a plain sans whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Both keep the line steady.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-winky-sans: Goldman's lowercase stands unusually tall against its capitals, with wide, round letters set far apart. And Winky Sans, a modern sans-serif with capitals barely taller than lowercase, keeps a longer passage moving smoothly.
